title: Network & Application Security Services | Quadra
description: Quadra, a global award-winning partner, architects the Intelligent Enterprise for the world's leading businesses. We transform complex Cloud & AI innovation into a competitive advantage, built on 25 years of deep, vendor-agnostic architectural expertise.

blocks.text: Your email gateways and web applications are the most targeted entry points for attackers. How do you protect against phishing, business email compromise (BEC), and OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities in a cohesive way?

blocks.alt: 3 women sitting on chair in front of table with laptop computers

blocks.text: We architect a multi-layered defense for your critical ingress points. We leverage the industry-leading platforms from Fortinet and Barracuda to design a cohesive security architecture that protects your email gateways with AI-powered threat detection and your web applications and APIs with a robust Web Application Firewall (WAF).

Our capabilities, powered by Fortinet and Barracuda, are designed to protect your most targeted entry points—your web applications, APIs, and email gateways—from sophisticated attacks before they can breach your defenses.
AI-powered defense against phishing, BEC, and ransomware
